text.en: Most dog owners praise the social, cage-free environment where dogs enjoy interactive playtime and personalized attention. Clients appreciate that their pets return home happy and well-exercised after daycare. However, feedback is mixed due to strict breed intake rules; one owner noted their pit bull mix was declined based on photos alone without an in-person temperament assessment.

Clients are very satisfied with the grooming and boarding results at the Arts District facility. Dog parents note that their pets return looking clean, properly brushed, and neatly trimmed after bath or styling appointments. Reviewers who utilized in-home mobile grooming also commended the thoroughness of the service and the low-stress experience for their pets.

Pet owners frequently highlight the welcoming and attentive demeanor of the facility staff. Reviewers appreciate receiving detailed updates regarding their dog's behavior during daycare stays, along with helpful guidance on daily pet care. Mobile grooming staff sent for home appointments are also described as courteous, skilled, and gentle with dogs.

q.en: Does Bone Sweet Bone Arts District offer cage-free daycare?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate the cage-free setting that emphasizes open playtime and socialization for dogs.

q.en: Are all dog breeds accepted for daycare?

a.en: No, a reviewer reported that pit bull mixes were not accepted for daycare based on facility breed policies.

q.en: Is in-home mobile grooming available through this location?

a.en: Yes, a client noted that a skilled groomer was dispatched directly to their home with complete grooming equipment.

q.en: Do pet parents receive updates on their dog's stay?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention receiving thorough debriefs and updates upon picking up their dogs.
